about.title: June Lake (California)
about.extract: June Lake is a subalpine lake within the Inyo National Forest, in Mono County, eastern California. It is at an elevation of 7,621 ft (2,323 m) in the Eastern Sierra Nevada.

sites.name: June Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $32 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: June Lake Campground is located in the Eastern Sierra, near the town of June Lake, at an elevation of 7,600 feet. This campground has 28 campsites. Drinking water is available. Flush toilets are available. 14 Day stay limit. Each site is equipped with a bear locker. Campsites are located in a…
sites.directions: Take US 395 to its southern junction with State Highway 158. Take 158 2.3 miles. Campground is on the right just past Fire Station. Campground is located in the town of June Lake.
sites.restrictions: Dogs must always be on leash and under owner control. Maximum stay 14 days. Active bear area. All food must be secured overnight and when not attended; bear boxes are provided and must be used (typical bear box size 48" x 30" x 36"). Always keep a clean camp and do not feed wildlife.
